messages:
Elaine: quick follow-up from yesterday's webinar — goal: publish gated replay + 3 social clips + embargoed benchmark PDF tomorrow AM. Need owners for: captions (multi-geo), clip trimming, HubSpot tagging + routing, legal sign-off on benchmarks. TL;DR: who can take what?
Mike: I can own the HubSpot mapping and email replay send. Question — do we want to score leads by watch % + CTA clicks? suggested tiers: >50% watch -> MQL, clicked demo CTA -> SQL flag.
Sanjay: I’ll grab the Zoom recordings and run the caption job. Deploy-bot just uploaded raw files: `gs://redwood-webinars/2026-03-20/real-time-embeddings/recording.mp4` (will confirm). I’ll also generate SRTs and a speaker-aligned transcript.
deploy-bot: Recording uploaded to GCS: gs://redwood-webinars/2026-03-20/real-time-embeddings/recording.mp4 (size: 1.9GB)
Mike: for HubSpot mapping — we should capture: utm_source, utm_campaign, webinar_id, demo_clicked boolean. Zapier flow: New HS form submission -> add hs_tags (webinar, region) -> webhook to routing lambda -> assign owner.
Elaine: clip plan: 3 short edits (2m product demo highlight, 45s benchmark headline, 30s CTA). Sanjay can you export MP4s + thumbnails? also need clip timecodes.
Sanjay: yeah — will create clips with ffmpeg snippets. example command for a 45s clip: `ffmpeg -ss 00:23:40 -i recording.mp4 -t 00:00:45 -c copy clip-benchmark-45s.mp4` I’ll push clips to `gs://redwood-webinars/2026-03-20/clips/` and add a JSON manifest with timecodes.
Zoe: legal note — for EU registrants we need an explicit consent checkbox on the replay form that references data processing and marketing contact. Also: benchmark PDF is embargoed until legal sign-off and speaker approval. please don’t publish the PDF link until I confirm.
Mike: understood — I’ll hold the benchmark asset out of the email template until Zoe gives the green. For emails: A/B test two subject lines: 1) "Watch: Real-time embeddings in production" 2) "New benchmark: lower latency, same quality" — we’ll send to high-engagement first wave.
Elaine: tagging/UTM plan: include region param so we can route to local SDRs. HubSpot tags: `webinar_replay`, `rt-embeddings`, `region-eu` etc. Mike add the exact tag names to the Zap.
Sanjay: captions/localization — I’ll auto-generate SRT, then run a quick QC pass for accuracy for en/us and en/uk. If we need translations (es, fr, de) we should queue with transifex/localization vendor — timeline +48h.
Zoe: also ensure speaker names are spelled correctly in the replay player and on the landing page. I’ll review the speaker consent forms by 08:00 PT.
Elaine: ownership recap: Mike -> HubSpot + email send; Sanjay -> final SRTs, clips, manifest, upload; Zoe -> legal/benchmark approval; Elaine -> landing page + replay gating + Slack notify.
Mike: for lead-tiering rule (for ops): `if watch_pct >= 50 then add 'mql_webinar'; if demo_click == true then add 'hot_demo' and notify #sales` — Sanjay can we add watch_pct from player events to the HS webhook?
Sanjay: yes — player emits `play_progress` events with percentages. I’ll wire the playback webhook to the Zapier lambda to include watch_pct in the HS contact properties.
Elaine: ok timeline: clips + SRTs by 10:30am PT, HubSpot mapping + email draft by 11:00am PT, legal final by 8:00am PT — publish replay after legal sign-off and after Mike's send window is set. Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept your task.
Mike: :thumbsup: I’m on it.
Sanjay: :thumbsup: starting the exports now.
Zoe: :thumbsup: will review and reply with any redlines.
Elaine: thanks — I’ll update the marketing task in Asana and post the final publish message in #marketing when live.
